title: 32 things we learned in NFL Week 7: As trade deadline nears, so do showcase opportunities

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 32 things we learned in NFL Week 7: As trade deadline nears, so do showcase opportunities
sources.description: With the cutoff to acquire players just two weeks away, Sundays will become showcase opportunities for certain players – and some seemed to take advantage in Week 7.
